license.statement: English Wikipedia article text at the frozen oldids is CC BY-SA 4.0. English Wikibooks text is CC BY-SA 4.0 as stated by the retained Wikibooks:Copyrights oldid 4622060, which was re-fetched and found byte-identical to the repository record. Page history for each frozen oldid identifies contributors. Linked media, Phonos, and audio are not covered.

decisions.scope: Exact spans for word order, respectful written Вы capitalization, two indeclinable abbreviation examples, short-form adjectives, passive participles, verbal adverbs, active participles, and the bookish-speech observation about adverbial participles. The rest of the article is retained and not ingested as curriculum.
Letter-name cells from the frozen alphabet table for Unit 30 review only. Unit 1 remains the first introduction. Embedded audio, Phonos, and Commons media are not admitted.
Only the address-notation lines and their abbreviation glosses. Anecdotal postal advice is excluded.
Claims that a postal index is not vital, that delivery time is predictable, personal recommendations, and international hearsay stay out of learner-facing content.
Wiktionary remains excluded. No entry is admitted for particles or any other strand.
Phonos, pronunciation.ogg, and Commons media linked from the frozen pages are not admitted and are not bound as audio.
The private owned PDF is not curriculum. Its prose, examples, exercises, readings, and page images are not admitted.
A current page, a URL without oldid, a search snippet, or a commercial grammar page is not a frozen record.
